newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Oil Search plans more PNG drilling.
newsitem.headline: Oil Search plans more PNG drilling.

text.p: Papua New Guinea (PNG) petroleum producer and explorer Oil Search Ltd said on Friday it had applied for the rights to explore a permit located north of the onshore Moran oil discovery.
The company said it was the only applicant for PPL 199 in the Papuan Foldbelt with an area of about 1,190 square kilometres. Its bid is subject to approval by the PNG government.
The company also said it and its partners in PPL 193 were considering the back-to-back drilling of two wells from late 1997.
It said access to the first well, Kimu One, was nearing completion and it was likely that the second well would test the Koko prospect in the south of the licence.

Oilsearch has a 30 percent stake in PPL 193 along with Mobil Corp unit Ampolex (Papua New Guinea Pty Ltd) and Mosaic Oil NL unit Mosaic Oil Nuigini Pty Ltd. Gedd (PNG) Pty Ltd has a 10 percent interest.
